record.file_problem: README and file list only; code was not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README describes a weight-editing approach and explicitly claims it lessens refusal, but reports no measured results.
record.gate_note: The README says three abliteration methods were applied and that layer-specific abliteration worked best in practice. It gives no method-by-method refusal outcomes or measured comparison; only the general claim that abliteration lessens refusal is recorded.
record.test_reason: A work-in-progress tool repository that applies abliteration to a Llama 70B model. The README states no refusal rates, prompt sets, baselines or capability measures. Its line about lessening refusal explains the method's intuition rather than reporting a result. The 'layer-specific works best in practice' remark is anecdotal and has no numbers. The repository relies on the V2 technique as a tool and gives no results that bear on whether any version holds.
record.authors_conclusion: Largely correct, but none of it is backed by reported measurements. The author says layer-specific abliteration, which computes a direction per targeted layer, worked best in practice. The author expects prompts outside the contrast-prompt distribution may still be refused. The author suspects broader contrast prompts could hurt model performance. The author speculates that task-specific contrast prompts could isolate and remove refusal for a chosen task at any model size.
record.recipe_differences: The README describes a weight-editing approach with directions computed for targeted layers, rather than reporting the original activation-projection intervention. Tool repository; the code was not inspected or run.
record.method_sensitivity: The README says layer-specific abliteration works best in practice and cautions that prompts whose activations fall outside the contrast prompts may still be refused.
record.problems: The README gives no measured refusal outcomes, prompt details, capability results, or uncertainty estimates; it labels the work in progress.
record.rows_left_out: No separate result rows for the three methods: the README does not report separate behavioral outcomes for them.

rows.check: The value is the README's description of what abliteration is meant to do. It is not a measured outcome: there is no refusal rate, prompt set or baseline, so 'partial' cannot be read from it. The subject is named 'Llama 3.2 70B Instruct' as the author states, but no 70B model exists in the Llama 3.2 family; it is likely Llama 3.1 or 3.3 70B. The weight formula is also written informally, as weight minus weight times direction, not as a proper projection.
